normalGate: ordinary npm test plus typecheck for TypeScript changes; no opt-in-only cleanup contract
counterexample: A completed dedicated test registration/publication remains native after declaration removal or collection disconnect; existing compensation is not normal retirement.

cases.boundary: actual hv_spec -> hv_plan with SQLite and registered capabilities
cases.expected: Omission yields zero mutations; exact retirement is reachable and never plans registration/upload/deployment. Wrong predecessor, provider, repository or environment rejects.

cases.boundary: actual installation journal and command planner
cases.expected: Validated historical completion survives a stale readiness read. Pending/uncertain creation, lost browser registration and malformed evidence cannot be bypassed into deletion.

cases.boundary: real provider client with independently reconstructed serialized contracts
cases.expected: Same name with changed UID/project/account/tenant/version is rejected. Exact already-absent identity is idempotent only under documented authorized absence semantics.
Exact DELETE path/body and supported preconditions only; CAPTCHA/Graph empty body, SendGrid exact key ID; no invented etag or force/purge defaults.
Active consumers or unknown inventories block. Failed/pending consumer removal prevents key/image/data deletion. Cleanup authority and source outlive dependent cleanup.

cases.boundary: write-ahead SQLite attempts and provider transport
cases.expected: Lost acknowledgment, timeout, process restart and local CAS failure preserve the exact target/operation and do not send a second DELETE. Definite rejected retry uses existing exact confirmation.

cases.boundary: real serialized observations plus SQLite receipt/binding update
cases.expected: GCS soft deletion, Entra deleted item, GCP DELETE_REQUESTED and AWS Retain are not permanent erasure. Tombstones survive active binding removal and parent cleanup.

cases.boundary: actual local handoff HTTP/browser and callback/status
cases.expected: Reviewed app/client identity, origin/nonce/CSRF/current owner authority remain fixed. Invalid provider destinations, auth failure, anonymous404 and user ack alone cannot invent verified native deletion.
All five operator applications and AWS/GCP artifact capabilities reviewed; Azure publication is explicitly unsupported. New capabilities cannot silently omit retirement classification.
Retirement cannot satisfy setup/image/reference readiness or trigger recreation. Older hosted v1 response shapes remain unchanged; unsupported older local clients fail closed.
Preserve shared sender/account/management connection/repository, foreign GitHub installations, unrelated permissions and unknown resources. Exact map CAS preserves concurrent unrelated state.

cases.boundary: reviewed local cloud scope planner and real serialized project/group/stack clients
cases.expected: Require original parent lifetime plus exclusive whole-scope review; preserve billing account/subscription/tenant. Unknown child inventory blocks narrow cleanup; no implicit lock removal/retention weakening.

cases.boundary: MCP/CLI output and persisted receipts on success/error
cases.expected: No runtime credentials, provider echo bodies, browser tokens or secret values appear; safe IDs, dispositions and classified incomplete outcomes remain useful.

cases.boundary: separately approved actual provider accounts and browser handoffs
cases.expected: Review -> stop consumers -> retire exact test targets -> verify active absence/retained state -> restart readback without repeated effects. Offline passes remain ready-for-live, not proof of complete native teardown.

registered provider adapters and ordinary provider-roster tests
shared hv_spec/hv_plan metadata, CLI/MCP results and installed lifecycle guidance
